title: 1 John: so that you may know
note: Rebuilt on 2026-11-26 from the Bible Explorer film of the same slug. lines: First John reads like a sermon written down, with no greeting and no named writer.
A group had left these churches, taking a new teaching about Jesus, and those who stayed wondered whether they really knew God. John writes to steady them.

scripture.text: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us.

lines: John works like a composer with a few themes: light, love, truth, obedience, and belief. He comes back to each from a new angle.
God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

scripture.text: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

chapters.kicker: Watch for: come in the flesh
lines: The letter begins with witnesses who heard, saw, and touched the Word of life. Against teachers who said the divine Christ only seemed to have a body, John insists he came in the flesh.
A spirituality that despises the body soon despises the neighbor.

scripture.text: which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands

lines: Three marks keep returning: believing the truth about Jesus, keeping God's commands, and loving one another. John won't let them be pulled apart.
They were written to steady people, not to make tender consciences anxious.

scripture.text: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.

lines: John holds two truths together. Anyone who says he has no sin deceives himself, and God forgives and cleanses those who confess.
He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Yet a child of God doesn't settle into sin. Don't deny your sin, and don't make peace with it.

scripture.text: He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

lines: God is love, and love is defined by what God did: he sent his Son. So love is concrete, laying down one's life and opening the hand to a brother in need.
Perfect love drives out the dread of judgment.

scripture.text: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

lines: Christians differ on who wrote the letter, on how to read the words that a child of God does not keep on sinning, and on how assurance works. This film takes no side.
The letter's antichrists were teachers who denied that Jesus is the Christ come in the flesh, and this film names no one living today.
Read it in one sitting, aloud if you can, with John's Gospel open beside it. Remember the split behind it.
And let it ask where your confidence before God rests.
John writes so that you may know that you have eternal life.

scripture.text: so that you may know that you have eternal life.
